description: This file defines an interface and a class related to fault injection in transaction coordination within the Orleans framework. It is part of the test kit for Orleans.Transactions, focusing on simulating fault conditions during transaction coordination for testing purposes.

classes.name: IFaultInjectionTransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: Interface for a transaction coordinator grain with fault injection capabilities in Orleans testing.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionCoordinatorGrain
classes.description: Implementation of the fault injection transaction coordinator grain for simulating transaction behaviors and faults.

methods.name: MultiGrainSet
methods.description: Sets a new value across multiple grain instances.

methods.name: MultiGrainAddAndFaultInjection
methods.description: Adds a specified number to multiple grains and optionally injects faults.
